title: Ride-hailing live tracking: rider watches that never really stop
name: Driver location fan-out

questions.prompt: The live-tracking service's heap grows all day and the pods get restarted every night. Each driver ping now takes milliseconds, and logs show MaxListenersExceededWarning for busy drivers. Riders whose driver was reassigned also report the map jumping between the old and new driver. The ops dashboard shows normal watcher counts. Fix tracking/tracker.ts so the tests pass.
